channel: H+ + Na(3s) -> Na+ + H(n), n = 1, 2, 3 (total one-electron capture with an explicit shell mix)

hydrogen_levels: NIST ASD H I levels; shell excitation = statistical-weight centroid over nlj levels; sample the shell n only
